target_customer: Mechanical engineers and engineering teams using SolidWorks, NX, Creo, Fusion 360 or Onshape
problem: Legacy CAD runs on 1980s kernels, is slow to open files, and designing is a tedious multi step process.
business_model: Free desktop download for individuals with paid team licensing by contact
product_category: AI-native mechanical CAD software with custom kernel

founders.name: Michael Baron
prior_employers: SpaceX (3x intern: Raptor combustion simulation, Dragon GNC, Starshield flight software)
founders.background_notes: Solo founder; education not on YC page.

competitors.name: Zoo (KittyCAD)
competitors.what: Builds its own geometry kernel and text to CAD agent
competitors.traction_then: Zookeeper agent in Zoo Design Studio

competitors.name: AdamCAD
competitors.what: Text to 3D CAD web app and Onshape plugin (YC W25)

competitors.name: SolidWorks, Onshape and Fusion 360
competitors.what: Incumbent CAD built on legacy kernels

technical_complexity.rationale: A custom parametric B-Rep kernel is research grade work that normally takes large teams years; one founder attempts it, and production scale performance is unproven.

defensibility.rationale: A working modern kernel would be hard to copy, but file format compatibility and switching costs favor incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were adding AI features; no action against Aurorin reported.

market_need_then: Engineers complain about slow CAD (company claim of 4 hour file opens) and AI native tools drew attention in 2026.

identity.visual_style: Clean minimal layout with large 3D render hero
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, short, problem solution headlines such as CAD software shouldn't fight you

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Claude Code for Mechanical Engineers; The first modern CAD software
branding.community_and_virality: Launch drew mixed public reaction and a StartupHub profile.

brand_strength.rationale: Pitch line borrows a known brand idea and spread on launch, but the name is close to Aurora brands and Aurorin trademarks are held by other owners.

outcome_analysis: Aurorin CAD is a solo founder Winter 2026 company building its own CAD kernel, with a free public launch in January 2026 and no exit or failure. The technical bet is large for one person, so the outcome hinges on kernel performance and file compatibility with existing CAD tools.
notes: Aggregators disagree: VCBacked, StandOut and StartupHub say $500K pre-seed from Y Combinator (March 2026); YesPress says a $130K seed in January 2026. No primary source; not recorded as a round. CB Insights lists the stage as Seed VC. A commentary flags the solo, student-stage team. Founded year not found. Competitor dates are approximate (Zoo source Feb 2026).
